## Biological narrative

**What Ki-67 actually reports.** MKI67 encodes a chromatin-associated protein present in every active phase of the cell cycle (G1/S/G2/M) and absent in G0; its abundance is graded and phase-dependent, accumulating through the cycle and peaking in G2/M (Scholzen & Gerdes, *J Cell Physiol* 2000; Miller et al., *Cell Rep* 2018). Per-cell Ki-67 protein therefore reads out "is this cell cycling now or very recently." In breast cancer, Ki-67 is a core prognostic marker, differs strongly across intrinsic subtypes (low in luminal A, high in HER2-enriched/basal-like; Cheang et al., *JNCI* 2009), and is notoriously heterogeneous *within* a single tumor ("hot spots"; Dowsett et al., *JNCI* 2011). So variation among tumor cells in one FFPE section has two candidate sources: (i) different cell-cycle states, and (ii) different upstream drivers of those states.

**What this experimental design can uniquely resolve.** CosMx SMI measures RNA and protein in the *same* spatially resolved cell in FFPE tissue (He et al., *Nat Biomed Eng* 2022). This gives three handles: (1) same-cell coupling of Ki-67 protein to transcriptional programs; (2) x,y coordinates to test whether Ki-67 states are organized into spatial niches; and (3) computational exclusion of blood cells, which removes Ki-67-positive proliferating leukocytes that would otherwise confound a proliferation readout. Critically, within one tumor the somatic driver lesions (ESR1, ERBB2, CCND1, TP53) are largely shared by descent — so the dominant *externally imposed, spatially graded* regulator of cell-cycle entry/exit in solid tissue is oxygen tension.

**Mechanistic chain.** Hypoxia is a well-documented cytostatic signal: HIF-1α functionally counteracts MYC (Koshiji et al., *EMBO J* 2004) and is required for hypoxia-induced G1 arrest (Goda et al., *Mol Cell Biol* 2003), acting together with induction of CDK inhibitors (CDKN1A/p21, CDKN1B/p27) and hypophosphorylated RB, which silences the E2F-driven proliferation module (TOP2A, CCNB1, MCM2, PCNA, MKI67). Conversely, cells in oxygenated, stroma-proximal niches keep receiving mitogenic input (e.g., CAF-derived CXCL12/HGF; Orimo et al., *Cell* 2005) and continue cycling. This is consistent with the long-standing histopathological observation that perinecrotic/hypoxic zones are Ki-67-poor (Höckel & Vaupel, *JNCI* 2001).

## Committed hypothesis (single mechanism)

**Cell-to-cell variation in Ki-67 protein among breast cancer cells in this tissue is caused by variation in cell-cycle state — E2F-active cycling versus RB-mediated quiescence — and this state is spatially imposed by microenvironmental hypoxia: tumor cells in HIF-1α-active niches (high CA9/SLC2A1/VEGFA/LDHA transcripts) arrest in G0/G1 via HIF-1α-mediated MYC antagonism and CDKN1A/CDKN1B induction and lose Ki-67 protein, whereas cells in oxygenated niches maintain CCND1–CDK4/6-driven RB phosphorylation, E2F activity (MKI67/TOP2A/CCNB1/MCM2/PCNA), and high Ki-67 protein.**

Key molecules: HIF1A, CA9, SLC2A1, VEGFA, LDHA (hypoxia module); MYC, CCND1, CDK4/6, RB1, E2F1, CDKN1A, CDKN1B (the switch); MKI67, TOP2A, CCNB1, MCM2, PCNA (cycling module). Pathway: hypoxia → HIF-1α → G1 arrest; cyclin D–CDK4/6–RB–E2F. Cell states: cycling vs. quiescent.

## Testable predictions

1. Same-cell RNA–protein coupling: per-tumor-cell Spearman correlation of Ki-67 protein with the E2F/G2M RNA module is strongly positive; Ki-67 protein should track the module (and G2/M markers) at least as well as MKI67 RNA itself, since the protein is graded and accumulates through the cycle (Miller et al. 2018). Analyze Ki-67 protein as a continuous variable, not binarized.
2. Hypoxia association: per-cell Ki-67 protein correlates negatively with a hypoxia module score (whichever of CA9, SLC2A1, VEGFA, LDHA, NDRG1, BNIP3, ADM, ANGPTL4 are in the panel), after regressing out the cell-cycle module and subtype-state covariates (ESR1/GATA3/ERBB2 modules).
3. Spatial structure: Ki-67 protein is spatially autocorrelated among tumor cells (Moran's I / Ripley's K); Ki-67-low cells co-localize with hypoxia-module-high cells and lie farther from PECAM1/VWF+ vessels; Ki-67-high cells cluster near stroma/vasculature.
4. Mediation: the hypoxia module's effect on Ki-67 protein is mediated through suppression of the E2F module (formal single-cell mediation analysis).
5. Orthogonal validation: multiplex IF on the same/adjacent section for CAIX, Ki-67, p21 (± pRB) — CAIX-high tumor cells should be Ki-67-low/p21-high.
6. Perturbation: patient-derived breast tumor organoids under 1% O₂ lose Ki-67 (rescued by reoxygenation), blunted by HIF1A knockdown or constitutively active cyclin D–CDK4/6 signaling.

**Falsification criteria:** if Ki-67-low tumor cells are spatially intermingled rather than clustered, or hypoxia scores do not negatively predict Ki-67 protein after controlling for the cell-cycle module, the spatial component is wrong (the proximal cell-cycle coupling could still hold).

## Established vs. new

- **(a) Established:** every molecular link is literature-supported — Ki-67's cell-cycle dependence and graded expression (Scholzen & Gerdes 2000; Miller et al. 2018), subtype-linked Ki-67 in breast cancer (Cheang et al. 2009; Dowsett et al. 2011), the CCND1–CDK4/6–RB–E2F axis as the breast cancer proliferation engine (O'Leary et al., *Nat Rev Clin Oncol* 2016), and HIF-1α-mediated hypoxic cell-cycle arrest (Goda et al. 2003; Koshiji et al. 2004).
- **(b) New testable mechanism:** the quantitative, single-cell, spatially resolved claim — that the hypoxia gradient *within this tumor section* explains a measurable fraction of Ki-67 protein variance among individual tumor cells via the RB–E2F switch, with the same-cell RNA→protein coupling and mediation structure specified above. This is falsifiable at a resolution neither bulk Ki-67 IHC nor dissociated scRNA-seq can achieve.

**Alternatives considered and deprioritized:** (i) intrinsic subtype-state heterogeneity (ESR1-high luminal vs. ERBB2/basal-like cells) — plausible for mixed-lineage tumors, included as a covariate, but shared clonal driver architecture makes it less likely to dominate within-tumor variance; (ii) immune cytostasis (IFN-γ/CD8 contact) — testable in the same framework but a weaker prior in most breast tumors; (iii) post-transcriptional RNA–protein decoupling of Ki-67 — directly quantifiable as a residual in the same-cell CosMx measurement.

**Key references:** Scholzen & Gerdes, *J Cell Physiol* 2000; Miller et al., *Cell Rep* 2018; Cheang et al., *JNCI* 2009; Dowsett et al., *JNCI* 2011; O'Leary et al., *Nat Rev Clin Oncol* 2016; Koshiji et al., *EMBO J* 2004; Goda et al., *Mol Cell Biol* 2003; Orimo et al., *Cell* 2005; Höckel & Vaupel, *JNCI* 2001; He et al., *Nat Biomed Eng* 2022.
